stem: A simple pendulum of length L and mass m completes one full oscillation. What is the net work done by gravity on the pendulum bob?
A solid uniform sphere of mass M and radius R rolls without slipping down an incline. What fraction of its total kinetic energy is rotational kinetic energy?
Object A (mass 2 kg, velocity 3 m/s East) collides with Object B (mass 1 kg, velocity 4 m/s North) and they stick together. What is the speed of the combined mass after collision?
A ball of mass m attached to a string of length R is rotated in a vertical circle. What is the minimum speed required at the top of the loop to keep the string taut?
A variable force F(x) = 3x^2 + 2 (in Newtons) acts on a 2 kg mass along the x-axis from x = 0 to x = 2 m. If it starts from rest, what is its kinetic energy at x = 2 m?
A car of mass m accelerates from rest with constant acceleration a. What is the instantaneous power delivered by the engine as a function of time t?
A force-time graph for a particle is a triangle with base along the t-axis from t=0 to t=6 s and peak force 10 N at t=3 s. What is the magnitude of impulse delivered?

A shell of mass 3m moving horizontally with speed v0 explodes into two fragments. One piece of mass m falls vertically with zero horizontal speed. What is the horizontal speed of the remaining 2m fragment?
A heavy block of mass M moving at speed V undergoes a head-on elastic collision with a stationary light marble of mass m (where M >> m). What is the approximate speed of the marble after collision?
A curved road of radius R is banked at angle theta so that a car traveling at speed v can negotiate the turn without friction. Which formula correctly expresses theta?
The potential energy function of a system is given by U(x) = x^3 - 3x (in Joules). What is the equilibrium state of the particle at x = 1 m?
A conical pendulum consists of a mass m on a string of length L swinging in a horizontal circle at constant angular velocity omega. What is the tension T in the string?
A block of mass m is dropped from height h above an uncompressed vertical spring of stiffness k. Which equation determines the maximum compression x of the spring?
A particle moves along a circular path of radius R at constant speed v under centripetal force Fc. How much work is done by Fc during half a revolution?
A ball dropped from height H rebounds to height h after hitting a floor. What is the coefficient of restitution e for the impact?
